label: Immanuel Wallerstein
identity_rationale: Existing immanuel_wallerstein ID reused. The Yale collection names the scholar with the Columbia/Binghamton/Yale career, and the YaleGlobal memorial identifies the four-volume Modern World-System author; no namesake merger or new authority ID.

sources.title: Yale Library MS 1865: Immanuel Wallerstein collection of African liberation movement posters
sources.support: Born 28 September 1930; died in 2019. Direct institutional collection biography.
sources.check_scope: Printed p. 4 biographical section only; underlying archival holdings not consulted.

sources.support: Direct institutional memorial repeatedly gives death as 31 August 2019 and identifies the Yale scholar/Modern World-System author.
sources.check_scope: Memorial opening and biographical paragraphs read.

sources.title: Binghamton University Libraries, Immanuel Wallerstein papers BUA-0012
sources.locator: Biographical Note, first sentence and final sentence before obituary quotation
sources.support: First sentence gives 28 September 1930–31 August 2019, but a later sentence says 13 August 2019. This internally inconsistent witness is not independently sufficient for death-day precision.
sources.check_scope: Biographical Note inspected; internal contradiction explicitly retained.

limits: Birth day is supported by Yale Library. Death day uses the direct YaleGlobal memorial, corroborated by Binghamton’s opening date range. Binghamton’s conflicting later 13 August statement is retained as a source inconsistency, not silently normalized or treated as a second death date. No lifespan interval is added to the canonical graph.
